title: The Pillsbury Doughboy Serves Up Over-the-Top Biscuit Sandwiches in Partnership with Chain at the Limited-Time Short King Sandwich Shoppe - General Mills
summary: The collaboration comes amid continued momentum for Pillsbury’s refrigerated dough portfolio, including three consecutive years of growth for cookies and win...
body_markdown:
## Key Takeaways:


- Pillsbury is teaming up with Chain to open the limited-time Short King Sandwich Shoppe at Westfield Topanga in Los Angeles from October 8 through November 6.
- The Doughboy-inspired menu features four over-the-top biscuit creations, including the 8.75-inch Doughboy Deluxe stacked with breakfast sausage, egg, fried chicken, peach hot honey, pimento cheese and cinnamon-baked apples.
- Fans can shop for limited-edition Pillsbury by Chain merch, including a Crescent Rolls-inspired crossbody bag in person at the Shoppe and online at[eatatchain.com/collections/pillsbury](https://eatatchain.com/collections/pillsbury) .


**MINNEAPOLIS –** Pillsbury knows good things come in small packages and even greater things come between two flaky biscuits. That’s why Pillsbury is teaming up with Chain, the American Pop Cuisine brand founded by B.J. Novak, to debut the Short King Sandwich Shoppe, a playful tribute to Poppin’ Fresh himself.


Inspired by the Pillsbury Doughboy’s iconic 8.75-inch stature, the month-long pop-up at Westfield Topanga Mall in Los Angeles serves up extravagant biscuit sandwiches alongside a limited-edition Pillsbury by Chain merch collection available to fans nationwide.


The Short King Sandwich Shoppe serves three over-the-top, chef-driven biscuit sandwiches inspired by brunch, dinner and dessert — plus the Doughboy Deluxe, which brings all three together in one sandwich:


- **Rise & Shine – Brunch** – Breakfast sausage, folded egg and sharp cheddar get stacked on a Pillsbury biscuit with habanero hot sauce, bringing a little heat to the morning.


- **Peachy Keen Clucker – Dinner** – Southern fried chicken meets peach hot honey and Hatch chili pimento cheese for a sweet, spicy and savory spin on the classic chicken biscuit.


- **Sweet Reign – Dessert** – Cinnamon-baked apple and clotted cream top a fennel pollen-buttered biscuit, bringing warm, buttery and sweet flavors together in every bite.


- **Doughboy Deluxe** – Brunch, dinner and dessert come together in one gloriously over-the-top biscuit sandwich stacked to 8.75 inches tall — the same height as the Pillsbury Doughboy in his signature chef’s hat.


The collaboration comes as Pillsbury continues to build momentum by giving fans more of what they love — more flaky layers, more* cinnamon and more** icing, to name a few — across its popular refrigerated dough products.


“Last year, we started making our biscuits with more of what people love — more flaky layers* for more delicious possibilities,” said Maria Carolina Comings, Vice President and Business Unit Director for Pillsbury at General Mills. “The Short King Sandwich Shoppe is a celebration of that ‘more’ mindset, teaming up with Chain to show just how much you can do with a Pillsbury biscuit in a way that’s playful, unexpected and unmistakably Pillsbury.”


For anyone who’s ever wondered how they stack up against the original Short King, guests can measure up to find out how many Doughboys tall they are at the Short King Sandwich Shoppe, open at the Westfield Topanga Mall ( *6600 Topanga Canyon Blvd* ) from October 8 through November 6.


## Wear Your Dough On Your Sleeve


Fans nationwide can get in on the fun with limited-edition Pillsbury by Chain merch available at the Shoppe and online at[eatatchain.com/collections/pillsbury](https://eatatchain.com/collections/pillsbury) . The collection includes Pillsbury x Chain tees starring Poppin’ Fresh and a crossbody bag inspired by the iconic Pillsbury Crescent Rolls canister.


“The Pillsbury Doughboy is a true cultural icon – and the original Short King,” said Nicholas Kraft, Co-Founder and Chief Creative Officer at Chain. “To be able to honor him with a sandwich that stands as tall and proud as him is a delicious dream.”


## Experience Pillsbury by Chain at Home


The Short King Sandwich Shoppe may be popping up in Los Angeles, but home cooks everywhere can bring a taste of the experience home with recipes available at[https://www.pillsbury.com/recipes/pillsbury-by-chain-short-kings-rise-shine-sandwiches/db2166c3-1ba2-49e3-b294-110786494c39](https://www.pillsbury.com/recipes/pillsbury-by-chain-short-kings-rise-shine-sandwiches/db2166c3-1ba2-49e3-b294-110786494c39) .
